_comment: Bank MICR field configuration per X9.100-160-1 / X9.100-161. Values below are Chase defaults. Replace with values from your bank's official MICR Document Specification form before live printing.

micr_fields._comment_positions: Positions 1-65, position 1 = leading/right edge. See buildspec.md §4.2.

auxiliary_on_us._chase_note: Chase uses 46-55 with last serial digit in box 46; adjust per your spec form.

positive_pay._comment_format: Supported: 'csv'. Add 'xml' or 'nacha' once bank confirms format.

reconciliation._comment_format: Supported: 'csv', 'bai2'. Set to match your bank's daily statement delivery.
